description.html: This 35x25x20 cm terrarium (17.5 L) comes with a polystyrene 3D background that faithfully reproduces the texture of stone or bark. Hand-sculpted and painted in natural tones, the background is more than decoration: it adds surfaces for climbing and hiding.

A length of 35 cm and a width of 25 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. On this floor area you can easily set up a basking spot and a cool side, the basis of proper reptile care. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

If the standard dimensions don't suit you, we build custom terrariums. Choose the size, film pattern, background style and extras such as LED lighting or a thermostat. Contact us for a quote. We deliver across Serbia.
